synthetic_planning_envelope.note: Synthetic per-band planning envelope from configs/latency_budgets.yaml; not production SLAs, partner commitments, or regulatory thresholds.

L0.description: Routine cases; cheaper model + minimal tool calls expected.

L1.description: Light support / communication; one tool lookup typical.

L2.description: Consent-sensitive draft path; evaluator runs additional checks.

L3.description: High-risk cases requiring human approval; stronger model + retrieval.

L4.description: Do-not-automate path; agent escalates without drafting.

measured_ms.note: Wall-clock latency for the deterministic runner only. The runner is near-instant; these numbers will become meaningful when an LLM is wired in.

synthetic_latency_envelope.comparison_note: Per-band comparison of measured mean latency to the synthetic planning envelope (p50/p95). Verdicts are categorical: within_p50, between_p50_and_p95, exceeds_p95, or no_budget. Budgets are synthetic planning envelopes — not production SLAs, partner commitments, or regulatory thresholds.

synthetic_cost_summary.note: Cost is a deterministic 0.0 placeholder for this synthetic run — no external model is called. Real cost surfaces here once an LLM is wired into the runner.
